fixes.resolution: Commit-only text is now accepted in an idle, ready, focused terminal without requiring a key event or preedit. Active and stale compositions remain distinct: cancellation, replacement and ownership invalidation still reject stale commits until fresh input re-arms the context. Tests cover initial/repeated commit-only text and commit-only text after recovery, alongside all existing cancellation/focus/history/disconnect guards. Ordinary typing no longer marks a composition active; a new regression verifies commit-only text after ordinary typing and a focus round trip.

Added the existing free settle() helper before the negative history-input/resize assertion so queued local-socket traffic is observed. The live-connection suite passes in normal, ASan/UBSan and TSan builds.
Updated the remaining active transport description to v4 and replaced the stale lifecycle-identity gap with the actual remaining registry/recovery work. Documentation file/heading links were checked.
Sanitized the historical receipt command to use <repo> instead of the local account path. The JSON parses and no /Users/ or /home/ path remains in this receipt.

Added an explicit nonempty-page assertion before max(), raising the existing CheckError caught by main. A controlled run with empty page discovery now exits 1 and writes passed:false plus "No history pages were written" to its JSON receipt; normal and real-ENOSPC runs still pass.

Direct service error shutdown now stops new input/output work and uses HistoryWorker::drain before exiting, allowing up to three seconds for the queued operations. Normal exit retains its existing bounded harvest/drain without adding another three-second window. Worker tests verify all 128 queued pages are persisted, new operations are rejected during drain, and a zero-budget deadline completes while work remains. The history-progress callback also catches exceptions and routes them through shutdown.

Cleared history_error_ together with history_failed_ at the start of an accepted retry. Corruption repair and real disk-full recovery now assert both a recovered page and an empty error message. Both scenarios pass; the service history fixture also passes under ASan/UBSan and TSan.
